name: Missing required env
description: config.py reads os.environ["SMTP_HOST"] at import time with no default, so the service will crash on startup if it is unset. SMTP_HOST is documented nowhere: not in README.md, not in .env.example, not in deployment config. SMTP_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, and API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS are all correctly documented in both README.md and .env.example, giving a visible contrast with the undocumented required variable.
notes_for_humans: CI happens to set SMTP_HOST itself, which is why the recorded run is green; that must not be read as evidence the variable is safely optional.
